answer: Trust propagates via bounded random walks across an attestation graph, starting from trusted roots; the walk mass reaching a set of sybil nodes bounds their aggregate voting weight. If a cluster has low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,¬S)/vol(S), its sparse external cut limits incoming walk flow over a fixed horizon. Thus adding internal sybil attestations cannot create trust by itself; dune, yarrow, and violet are merely node labels.
